substitutionTest.note: 333 baseline words to 139 shipped words, minus 58 percent, no baseline sentence surviving verbatim. The shipped attribution line, After Elinor Ostrom, is pass-authored under CTD-0007 and kept. Substitution mode; the pairing test does not apply and was not run.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0007's adaptation marking is the one recorded correction touching this section, and under R-CORRECTION-SCOPE it governs the attribution line alone: the pass's After Elinor Ostrom label is kept and the epigraph text returns to baseline beneath it. No settled decision governs the body. CTD-0006 is a query, so the baseline's claim that relational standing can govern access to the material foundations of life is restored and flagged to the item rather than softened. CTD-0055 and CTD-0045 hold the vision-versus-report modality question the shipped conditional tense had answered without a ruling.

findings.summary: The epigraph was rewritten, not merely marked as an adaptation.

evidence.baseline: Every institution faces the same decisive moment: the moment when the interests of its governors diverge from the interests of those it was founded to serve. The question is not whether this moment will come. It is whether the institution was designed, before that moment arrived, to survive it.
evidence.shipped: Every institution reaches a moment when the interests of its governors diverge from the interests of those it was meant to serve. A constitution prepares for that moment before it arrives.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0007's adaptation marking, extended past its scope.
findings.diagnosis: The item authorizes marking the opening honestly, and the pass did that well: the em dash attribution became the After form the volume now uses throughout. What the item does not authorize is rewriting the adaptation itself. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE marks the attribution line as the correction's span; the epigraph's three-sentence build, moment, question, design, is the movement the chapter then performs, and the shipped two-sentence summary flattens the question the design answers. Baseline text restored under the kept attribution.

findings.summary: The structure-not-people thesis was replaced by an operational definition the baseline never states.

evidence.baseline: The genius of constitutional design is the recognition that governance is ultimately not a question about people. It is a question about structure.
evidence.shipped: It is limiting what any ruler can do, distributing authority, and making correction possible when incentives change.

findings.diagnosis: The shipped triad is a reasonable gloss on constitutionalism, but it is not this book's claim, and the chapter's whole architecture, chambers, sunsets, dissolution, hangs on the people-to-structure turn the baseline states and the shipped text absorbs. The baseline's opening, the greatest political philosophers of the Western tradition were united, is unnamed-consensus form under catalog 4.27; it is restored as written and flagged for author review rather than repaired, because naming which philosophers is a research decision under section 9 of the standard, not an editorial one.

findings.summary: The power argument lost its ground and its self-annihilation claim, and its tense was softened to the conditional.

evidence.baseline: A network that can let relational standing govern access to the material foundations of life is a network of enormous power. ... An institution that minted such a currency while being governed by extractive logic would not merely be hypocritical. It would be self-annihilating, corroding the very substrate it depends upon.
evidence.shipped: Providence would handle intimate data, influence introductions, and perhaps help communities allocate stewardship. Those functions create power even if no one calls them power.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression and caution, in CTD-0055's requirements-not-facts direction without a recorded decision.
findings.diagnosis: The baseline argues from the currency's reach to the continuity requirement through the self-annihilation claim: an extractive governor of an anti-extractive currency corrodes its own substrate. The shipped text keeps the conclusion, governance must be continuous with values, and drops the argument that compels it, while shifting the institutional description from present to conditional. That modality shift is exactly what CTD-0055 asks for and exactly what it says must be done deliberately, with a control matrix, not silently in one section. Restored; the modality question is flagged to CTD-0055 and CTD-0045, never resolved here.

evidence.baseline: The epigraph attribution dash, the material-life mark, and the currency mark.

findings.diagnosis: The attribution dash is retired by the kept After form. The material-life mark introduced a specification, to land and water and seed, to the question of who is fed, and became a colon. The currency mark joined a dependent that-clause, and that this currency is destroyed by extraction, and became a comma.

debtImpact.note: The After Elinor Ostrom attribution is kept as the pass's honest marking; the epigraph text beneath it returns to baseline. The item still owns primary-source verification of the adaptation and the literary question of twenty-one nearly uniform attributed openings.

A network that can let relational standing govern access to the material foundations of life is restored at full strength. It is the premise of the item's question, stated here as the reason governance is the gravest question in the volume.

Present-tense institutional description restored; the shipped conditional had applied the item's requirements-not-facts direction without a ruling. The item owns the modality decision for the whole constitutional sketch.
This section opens the constitutional sketch the item owns. Restoration returns the sketch to its baseline strength so the item's legal and democratic review has the full text to review.
The vision-versus-report posture of the governance chapters is part of the item's publication-category decision.

reasoning.note: The full epigraph under the kept attribution, the Madison paragraph with its structure-not-people turn, and the reach argument from the Currency of Presence through the self-annihilation claim to the structure-embodies-value close.
The After Elinor Ostrom attribution line under R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, and the pass's italicization of Federalist No. 51 as an ordinary title-styling repair.

The shipped operational definition of constitutionalism, quoted in F2, and the shipped bounded power inventory, Providence would handle intimate data, influence introductions, and perhaps help communities allocate stewardship, quoted in F3. Both are hedged rivals of restored baseline claims, and both directions belong to CTD-0006 and CTD-0055 respectively. The shipped closing consequence, a structure that contradicts its purpose will eventually teach participants to distrust the purpose, is quoted here for the author; the baseline's under-pressure betrayal claim returns in its place.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT across three marks as recorded in F4.

openQuestions: The greatest political philosophers of the Western tradition were united is unnamed-consensus form, catalog 4.27. Restored as written; whether to name Madison's company or bound the claim is an author research decision under section 9.

The whole constitutional sketch is written in the present tense about an institution that does not exist. The shipped pass had converted it to the conditional. CTD-0055 and CTD-0045 own that decision; this pass restored the baseline tense and left the question open.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline under the twenty-rule standard, the corpus card, the volume card, and the debt ledger, with the surviving-sentence count taken first and the paired-deletion term sweep run before restoration.
regenerationTest.conclusion: Restoration converged in one generation. The chapter opens on the question it actually answers, the epigraph performs its build again under its honest attribution, and the two live canon directions, standing and modality, are flagged to their items with the shipped wording preserved.

authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation and the standing author instruction to restore from baseline and flag contests afterwards. Canon, doctrine, factual claims, and claim scope remain author decisions.
